field_notes.summary: Opening paragraph of the wiki page (often contains exact values, e.g. talisman percentages).

field_notes.infobox: All infobox fields of the page, cleaned (numbers parsed when purely numeric).

items.name: Piquebone Arrow
items.summary: Piquebone Arrow are a type of arrow in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Arrow whittled from animal bones. The tip is soaked in putrescence.
Releases a white smoke at the point of impact, luring in foes of human build who are not in combat, and drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state. Craftable item.
effect_details: Attracts the aggression of humanoid foes that are outside of combat, with the exception of Demi-humans, whom can be influenced even if they are within combat.

While Shattershard Arrows can be similarly used to attract the attention of a more varied pool of enemies than this item, they have the downside of often being incapable of attracting enemies with predetermined, scripted behavior. Like those those who are positioned behind corners and set up to ambush the player whenever they enter a certain location.
→ However as long as those stationed enemies are humanoid, Piquebone Arrows are capable of breaking them out of their script and forcibly attract their attention regardless.

details: x1 Thin Beast Bones
x2 Congealed Putrescence
x1 Human Bone Shard

items.name: Golden Great Arrow
items.summary: Golden Great Arrow is a type of Greatarrow in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Carved greatarrows made together with the Erdtree Greatbow. Deals holy damage.

Imbued with an oath-sworn incantation, which boosts the attack and defense of the archer and their nearby allies.
effect_details: Golden Great Arrows will release a golden aura wherever the they land -- this aura boosts the Attack Power of nearby allies by +7.5% (+2.5% against other players) and their damage reduction by +7.5% (+1.5% against other players) for 45 seconds.

details: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 500 runes.
10 Golden Great Arrows can be found inside a chest in the Sage's Cave.

notes: The Attack Power of the Golden Great Arrow scale with the Faith scaling of the Erdtree Greatbow.
The seal that is briefly created when the Greatarrow lands is the same as the one created when casting some Erdtree Incantations.
The buff from Golden Great Arrows count as an Aura Buff and do not conflict with Body Buffs or Weapon Buffs.

items.name: Radahn's Spear
items.summary: Radahn's Spear is greatbow ammunition in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greatarrows used by General Radahn during the festival of combat. These are in fact the many spears with which he was stabbed by the Cleanrot Knights.

Imbued with Radahn's gravitational power.

details: Found throughout the Wailing Dunes.
Purchaseable from Finger Reader Enia for 800 Runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

notes: Radahn's Spear gains a +20% damage buff when used while the Lion Greatbow is equipped in either the main-hand or off-hand.
→ This buff stacks with itself if the player has another Lion Greatbow equipped.

items.name: Meteor Bolt
items.summary: Meteor Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Enchanted work of craft made in tandem with the Full Moon Crossbow. The tip is embedded with glintstone.

Like a shooting star, these bolts leave a beautiful trail when fired. Deals magic damage.

details: Purchase:
→ Liurnia of the Lakes
→→ Can be purchased from the Isolated Merchant on the curving bridge outside the Academy of Raya Lucaria for 120 Runes.

items.name: Flaming Bolt
items.summary: Flaming Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolt with a fiercely burned tip. Deals powerful fire damage.

Used by survivors of Radahn's army to stave off the scarlet rot.

details: Purchase:
→ Caelid
→→ Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant of southern Caelid for 120 Runes.

items.name: Explosive Bolt
items.summary: Explosive Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description: Bolt tipped with a shard of Explosive Stone. Explodes on impact, dealing fire damage.

details: Loot:
→ Caelid
→→ x6 Found on a corpse by the cliffs of the ravine north of Caelem Ruins.
Purchase:
→ Mt. Gelmir
→→ Sold by the Nomadic Merchant of Mt. Gelmir for 160 Runes.

items.name: Perfumer's Bolt
items.summary: Perfumer's Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolt created with perfumer techniques. Used by nobles' guards and the like.

The point of impact explodes with sparks, dealing fire damage.

details: Random Drop:
→ Perfumers
→ Noble Page (5x, 10% chance for regular Page variant and 25% chance for High Page variant)

→→ The earliest available farm is two regular Pages inside of Tombsward Ruins while the generally most convenient farm is of the single High Page found down the second set of stairs on the path from West Capital Rampart Site of Grace to the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital (note that this enemy doesn't exist in Leyndell, Ashen Capital).

notes: → This boost makes them slightly stronger than Explosive Bolts.

items.name: Lightning Bolt
items.summary: Lightning Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolt tipped with a shard of Gravel Stone. Deals powerful lightning damage.

Used by worshippers of the ancient dragons.

details: Purchase:
→ Altus Plateau
→→ Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant on the southern end of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

items.name: Golden Bolt
items.summary: Golden Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolt blessed with an incantation of the Erdtree. Deals powerful holy damage.

Once used by guards of the Capital.

details: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 120 Runes.

items.name: Black-Key Bolt
items.summary: Black-Key Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolts used in Crepus' Black-Key Crossbow, an assassin's tool of exquisite craftsmanship.

The intricate spiral tip bores deep, injecting scarlet rot far into the flesh of its target.

details: Loot:
→ Roundtable Hold
→→ 20x found behind the first Imp Statue alongside the Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow.
→ Caelid
→→ 20x found on top of Sellia Gateway; can be accessed by traveling along the road southwest of the Church of the Plague.
→ Leyndell, Royal Capital
→→ 20x found in a room in the eastern wing of the Fortified Manor next to the Two Fingers' Prayerbook.
→ Lake of Rot
→→ 10x found on a corpse close to the first floor panel southwest of the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace.
Guaranteed Drop:
→ Altus Plateau
→→ 20x received automatically after successfully defeating Rileigh the Idle as part of the Volcano Manor assassinations questline.

items.name: Burred Bolt
items.summary: Burred Bolt are a type of bolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Bolt covered in thorns. One of the most horrific weapons used in the Shattering. Afflicts target with blood loss.

Difficult to remove once buried in flesh, causing appalling damage to the body.

details: Can be purchased from the Imprisoned Merchant of Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 200 Runes.

items.name: Bone Ballista Bolt
items.effect: Thick, whittled bone bolt, large as a spear
items.summary: Bone Ballista Bolt is a craftable greatbolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greatbolt as large as a spear carved from stout animal bones.
Craftable item.

Though the tip is certainly sharp, it does not fly particularly true.

details: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [13], found north of Bellum Church.

infobox.item_effect: Thick, whittled bone bolt, large as a spear
infobox.required_items: Hefty Beast Bone x1

items.name: Ballista Bolt
items.summary: Ballista Bolt is a type of Greatbolt in Elden Ring.
items.description: Greatbolt as large as a spear for use with Hand Ballista.

details: Loot:
→ x5 are found at the top of Forest Lookout Tower along with the Hand Ballista.
→ x5 Ballista Bolts can be found in Stormveil Castle, behind the main gate.
Purchase:
→ x5 Ballista Bolts are sold by Patches in Murkwater Cave for 300 Runes.
→ x8 are sold by the Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region for 300 Runes.
→ x15 are sold by the Isolated Merchant in the Weeping Peninsula region 300 Runes.
→ x5 are sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil Castle 300 Runes.
→ Unlimited Ballista Bolts are sold by the Hermit Merchant in the Capital Outskirts on the Altus Plateau 300 Runes.
→ Unlimited Ballista Bolts are sold by the Nomadic Merchant on Mt. Gelmir 300 Runes.
→ Unlimited Ballista Bolts are sold by the Hermit Merchant on the Mountaintops of the Giants 300 Runes.
→ Unlimited Ballista Bolts are sold by Moore in the Gravesite Plain for 300 Runes.

items.name: Explosive Greatbolt
items.summary: Explosive Greatbolt is a greatbolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Explosive Stone shards.

Detonates a large explosion on impact, dealing fire damage

details: Loot:
→ Mt. Gelmir
→→ x5 Found on a corpse guarded by two Abductor Virgins north-west of the Bridge of Iniquity Site of Grace.
→ Volcano Manor
→→ x5 Found on a corpse hanging on a balcony north of the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
Purchase:
→ Mt. Gelmir
→→ Sold by the Nomadic Merchant of Mt. Gelmir for 800 Runes.

items.name: Lightning Greatbolt
items.japanese_name: ライトニング大ボルト
items.summary: Lightning Greatbolt is a greatbolt in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Greatbolt tipped with a clump of Gravel Stone shards.

Deals powerful lightning damage.

details: Purchase:
→ Mountaintops of the Giants
→→ Sold by the Hermit Merchant of Mountaintops of the Giants for 500 Runes.

items.name: Rabbath's Greatbolt
items.summary: Rabbath's Greatbolt are a type of greatbolt in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Greatbolt tipped with a clump of glintstone shards. One of Spellmachinist Rabbath's innovative designs.

Detonates a large explosion on impact, dealing magic damage.
effect_details: Causes an explosion of Magic damage on point of impact.
Magic Attack Power is enhanced even further when fired from Rabbath's Cannon.

details: Purchased for 800 from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing.
